verdict.rationale: Canny tracks statuses on feedback ideas: status can be updated via MCP, the team's roadmap can be queried, and statuses sync with linked Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana issues. That gives a PM a status view of in-progress work tied to feedback, but nothing shows per-task blocker detail, last-update timestamps, or a real-time task-monitoring view. Missing for 10: real-time per-task status view, what each task is blocked on, last-update tracking, and any hands-on corroboration.
